summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of RoadBoss Highway Pilot Phase 2C: Twilio SMS + SendGrid Email integration. All 27 tests passed successfully. Real Twilio and SendGrid APIs are working correctly with fictional NANP 555-01XX demo numbers. All notification sends are properly audit-logged to MongoDB.

backend_issues.notes: No backend issues found. All endpoints working as expected.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend testing not performed (backend-only testing as requested)

passed_tests: GET /api/notifications/status - Returns correct Twilio and SendGrid configuration
POST /api/dispatch/sms - Admin dispatch SMS with auth checks (valid driver, invalid driver, empty message, driver role 403)
POST /api/admin/invite - Fleet invite emails with SendGrid (valid, duplicate email 400, driver role 403)
GET /api/admin/invites - Returns list of invites sorted by created_at desc
POST /api/notifications/hos-warning - HOS warning SMS to driver + admins with proper response structure
GET /api/notifications/logs - Audit log retrieval with filters (all, channel=sms, channel=email, limit)
POST /api/auth/forgot - Password reset email via SendGrid (no dev_token when email succeeds)
POST /api/auth/register - Welcome email sent on new user registration
POST /api/crash-events - Crash alert SMS to emergency contacts + admins (confirmed=true)
POST /api/roadside/dispatch - Roadside provider SMS with dispatch details
POST /api/inspections/{id}/certify - DVIR signed email to fleet admins
Phone normalization - Tested indirectly via SMS sends (E.164, 10-digit, formatted)
Audit log structure - All required fields present (id, created_at, channel, event_type, status, to, subject/body, provider_message_id, http_status, error)
Twilio integration - Real SMS sends to fictional NANP 555-01XX numbers (status=queued)
SendGrid integration - Real email sends (http_status=202 accepted)
Force reseed - Drivers now have correct phone numbers (+12145550101, +19015550102, etc.)

twilio_configuration.test_results: SMS successfully sent to fictional NANP 555-01XX numbers with status=queued
